info.title: FSP frontend handoff API
info.description: PROPOSED CONTRACT. Local stateful mock with synthetic data. This is not a statement that the Rust backend exists. JSON responses use camelCase. Salary is integer RUB/month before tax. No production authentication, code execution, external provider, or real LLM is implemented.

servers.description: Same origin; development Vite proxy forwards /api to 127.0.0.1:4010.
